gloss_en: Which IFC translator was used and are custom properties exported?
prompt: check which translator this ifc was exported with and whether my custom properties came through
expected_behavior: Read IfcApplication/header, list property sets present, report whether user-defined properties exist and on which classes.

prompt: half my walls are showing as proxy, why?? find them
expected_behavior: List IfcBuildingElementProxy, group by name/type/layer, explain likely IFC Manager mapping causes and propose reclassification.

gloss_en: Revit import of Archicad IFC missing slabs
prompt: archicad ifc into revit and slabs are gone, can u check if theyre even in the file
expected_behavior: Check IfcSlab/IfcCovering count and representations in the file, report missing geometry items.

gloss_en: Model far from origin after Revit link
prompt: model sits 20km from origin in revit, check IfcSite placement and map conversion
expected_behavior: Read IfcSite/IfcMapConversion/placement, report offsets and recommend shared coordinates fixes.

prompt: add classification ref (Uniclass) to all doors from their type name
expected_behavior: Create IfcClassificationReference for IfcDoor via type mapping and report changes.

prompt: compare export v3 and v4, what properties changed on walls
expected_behavior: Diff property sets by GlobalId for IfcWall, summarise added/removed/changed values.

gloss_en: How to export zone as IfcSpace
prompt: how do i get zones out as IfcSpace with areas
expected_behavior: Explain Archicad zones to IfcSpace mapping and Base quantities; check existing spaces in a model.

prompt: composite wall layers dont show as separate layers in the viewer. material layer set?
expected_behavior: Check IfcMaterialLayerSetUsage on walls; report which walls lack layer sets.

prompt: pull wall net area and volume per storey, qto empty for some
expected_behavior: Read Qto_WallBaseQuantities, group by storey, flag walls with no quantities.

prompt: list storeys w elevations, revit shows different levels
expected_behavior: List IfcBuildingStorey with elevations and element counts per storey.

prompt: are curtain walls exported with panels and mullions or one blob
expected_behavior: Inspect IfcCurtainWall aggregates, report IfcPlate/IfcMember parts.

prompt: ifc is 900mb, what is eating the size
expected_behavior: Report element counts by class and representation types, suggest reduction (mesh vs brep, merge).

prompt: pls check all IfcWall have FireRating and LoadBearing before we send to the revit team
expected_behavior: Validate property presence on IfcWall, list failing GlobalIds.

prompt: which translator should i pick when sending to a structural engineer on revit?
expected_behavior: Explain Coordination View 2.0 vs Design Transfer and IFC4 options, trade-offs.

prompt: how many doors and windows have openings in walls? some walls look solid
expected_behavior: Check IfcRelVoidsElement and IfcRelFillsElement, report unmatched doors/windows.

prompt: guids changed after re-export, clash issues cant track
expected_behavior: Explain IFC ID persistence in Archicad, compare GUIDs between files, report matches by name/position.
